tool_input.command: cd "$(pwd)" && sed -i "s/import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';/import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from 'react';/; s/as React.CSSProperties/as CSSProperties/" src/pages/OverviewPage.tsx && grep -n "CSSProperties" src/pages/OverviewPage.tsx
sed -i 's/^  dots = 0;/  dotCount = 0;/; s/this\.dots += /this.dotCount += /g; s/dots: this\.dots,/dots: this.dotCount,/' src/scene/scenes.ts && grep -n "dotCount" src/scene/scenes.ts
tool_input.description: Rename dots counter field in scenes.ts

tool_input.command: node pigment-snap.mjs /__scenes 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 15; Get-ChildItem .snaps | Select-Object Name

Remove-Item src/pages/SceneLab.tsx -Confirm:$false; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force design-system | Out-Null; Copy-Item design-packages/night-cartridge-1.3.0-rc.3/dist/tokens.css design-system/tokens.css; Copy-Item design-packages/night-cartridge-1.3.0-rc.3/dist/tokens.json design-system/tokens.json; (Get-FileHash src/styles/tokens.css).Hash -eq (Get-FileHash design-system/tokens.css).Hash
tool_input.description: Remove lab page, copy tokens, verify copy matches
